_meta.purpose: Deterministic, regex/keyword-only checks run in plain JavaScript against the user's rough prompt text before any Gemini Nano call. No rule here requires model judgment.
_meta.sync: Hand-mirrored from ../knowledge/patterns.md, core.md, grounding.md, techniques.md. Do not treat as auto-generated. Run scripts/validate-runtime.js after editing.

detectTypes.verbAbsence: fails (rule fires) if none of `verbs` appear as a whole word in the text
detectTypes.regex: fires if `pattern` (with optional `flags`) matches the text
detectTypes.keywordAbsence: fires if none of `keywords` appear in the text
detectTypes.keywordPresence: fires if any of `keywords` appear in the text
detectTypes.keywordPresenceWithoutPhrase: fires if any of `keywords` appear AND `excludePhrase` does not appear

no_task_verb.description: No recognized action verb found in the task text.

multiple_tasks.description: Two distinct task verbs joined by a conjunction, suggesting a bundled multi-task request.

no_format_specified.description: No length, structure, or format keyword present anywhere in the prompt.

vague_adjective.description: A vague, unmeasurable quality adjective is used without a concrete spec.

unresolved_placeholder.description: A bracketed placeholder like [industry] or [product] was left unfilled.

assumed_shared_history.description: The request assumes prior context or conversation history the model wasn't actually given.

invites_fabrication.description: Open-ended appeal to authority or an unsourced factual/statistical claim.

missing_stepwise_reasoning.description: Comparison, logic, or decision language present without a step-by-step instruction.
